 used to measure samples of demineralised water, potable water, industrial 
 water and waste water.

The smooth

If the

 the formation of condensate can lead to the faulty functioning of the 
 instrument. In this event, wait until the temperature of the instrument 
 reaches room temperature before putting the instrument back into operation.

If safe 
 operation is no longer possible, the instrument must be taken out of service 
 and secured against inadvertent operation.

Introduction
The compact InoLab pH 730 of WTW is used to determine pH range 0-14 and 
 used to measure samples of demineralised water, potable water, industrial 
 water and waste water.
This document was initiated by: Chemist / Lamiaa Ibrahem Ghowail reviewed by 
 Chemist / Zakiah Sultan revised by Chemist / Magdy Gad Elhaq G.M of 
 chemistry and accepted by Eng / Ibrahim Hassan head sector of Talkha power 
 station ( 750 M.W ).
This document is revised by quality control Chemist / Wael Tantawy, accepted 
 by Eng / Samir Abdel Gilel: inspection and quality control general director 
 & MPIS coordinator and certified by Eng / Mohamed Nageeb MDEPC inspection 
 and Quality Control Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
This measuring instrument was developed for use 
 in the laboratory. Thus, we assume that, as a result of their professional 
 training and experience, the operators will know the necessary safety 
 precautions to take when handling chemicals.
Place the instrument on a flat surface and 
 protect it against intense and heat.
Incorrect calibration of the pH electrode 
 will result in incorrect measured values. Therefore, regularly perform 
 calibration before measuring.

 the formation of condensate can lead to the faulty functioning of the 
 instrument. In this event, wait until the temperature of the instrument

Temperature Probe

 connected temperature probe is indicated by TP on the display.
